description: AICTIONBOT™ switch-over check by KULIC Advisory (tool 42), built on the Execution Toolkit template T06 (implementation tracker). kind system (new ERP or purchasing system) or supplier (switch to a new supplier), name, go_live date. Without a list it returns a 12-point checklist dated from the go-live (data, open orders, roles and approvals, training, test, supplier information, cut-over, post-launch support; or contract and notice, supplier set-up, samples, open orders, stock, tools and moulds, first delivery, first rating). With the team's own list (item, area, owner, due, status) it rates readiness red, yellow or green, lists blocked and overdue items, items without owner or date, and checklist points missing from the list. Always adds questions and answers for staff. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

items.description: Optional own list: item, area, owner, due, status (open, in progress, done, blocked).

kind.description: system for a new system, supplier (lieferant) for a new supplier. Default system.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

name.description: What is being switched, e.g. new purchasing system.
